newsitem.title: CANADA: Enscor unit to sell second cooling business.
newsitem.headline: Enscor unit to sell second cooling business.

text.p: Enscor Inc said on Friday its Equion Corp unit entered into a letter of intent to sell its industrial cooling products business to Thermal Dynamics, a division of privately owned Allagash Fluid Controls Inc of La Jolla, California, for about US$6.5 million.
Enscor said US$3.5 million would be payable at closing and the balance payable with interest over the 20-month period after closing.
Equion can earn up to an additional US$500,000 based on the achievement of certain base sales targets in the 12-month period following closing, Enscor said.
The deal is expected to close by the end of October.

Equion began selling its remaining automotive interests in the autumn of 1995. The sale of its industrial cooling business, together with the recent sale of Equion's aftermarket and heavy duty cooling business, will complete the process.
